alternatives.text: This can be used to direct connections to a different server instance. If a server receives a client Initial that contains an invalid Retry token but is otherwise valid, it knows the client will not accept another Retry token.
Note that a server has not established any state for the connection at this point and so does not enter the closing period.

If a server receives a client Initial that contains an invalid Retry token but is otherwise valid, it knows the client will not accept another Retry token. The server can discard such a packet and allow the client to time out to detect handshake failure, but that could impose a significant latency penalty on the client.
